تشتعلين (form VIII)
# تَشْتَعِلِينَ (taštaʕilīna) /taʃ.ta.ʕi.liː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِشْتَعَلَ (ištaʕala)
# تُشْتَعَلِينَ (tuštaʕalīna) /tuʃ.ta.ʕa.liː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِشْتَعَلَ (ištaʕala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
